name: tips_crm_monthly_execution_targets
query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tips_crm.monthly_targets (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), month_start date NOT NULL, target_type text NOT NULL CHECK (target_type IN ('rep', 'territory')), target_key text NOT NULL, target_value integer NOT NULL CHECK (target_value >= 0), created_by uuid REFERENCES tips_crm.profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE (month_start, target_type, target_key)); ALTER TABLE tips_crm.monthly_targets ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS monthly_targets_admin_read ON tips_crm.monthly_targets; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS monthly_targets_admin_write ON tips_crm.monthly_targets; CREATE POLICY monthly_targets_admin_read ON tips_crm.monthly_targets FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (tips_crm.has_permission('view_team_data') OR tips_crm.has_permission('all')); CREATE POLICY monthly_targets_admin_write ON tips_crm.monthly_targets FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (tips_crm.has_permission('manage_accounts') OR tips_crm.has_permission('all')) WITH CHECK (tips_crm.has_permission('manage_accounts') OR tips_crm.has_permission('all'));
